name: Divya Gokulnath
bio: Divya Gokulnath is an Indian entrepreneur and educator who is the co-founder and director of Byju’s, an educational technology company founded in 2012 in Bangalore, India.

name: Ankita Gaba
bio: Ankita Gaba is the co-founder of SocialSamosa.com. She is a social media strategist, speaker, consultant, and entrepreneur by trade. Not only that, but she also founded Superchooha, one of the earliest social media companies in the nation.She earned her business management degree from Wilson College. She graduated with her MBA from the Welingkar Institute of Management in 2010. In 2008, Gaba started working as a professional in the PR sector, handling publicity for films and celebrities.

name: Vandana Luthra
bio: Vandana Luthra, the creator of VLCC Health Care Ltd., an Asian, GCC, and African beauty and wellness conglomerate. She is also the chairperson of the Beauty & Wellness Sector Skill Council (B&WSSC), an initiative that provides training under the Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana schemes. After completing her graduation from the Polytechnic for Women in New Delhi she went to Europe to gain expertise in beauty, food and nutrition and skin care.

name: Namrata Bostrom
bio: Namrata Bostrom is the Co-founder of POPxo which is a leading fashion and lifestyle brand today. She is listed among the India’s female CEO’s with dollar value. Namrata Bostrom did her schooling from a school in New Delhi and now she is herself settled in New Delhi. She completed her MBA degree from London Business School. Namrata Bostrom is counted among the dollar value CEO’s and also the successful women entrepreneur in India.

name: Sheetal Ramkumar
bio: Sheetal Ramkumar is the Founder & CEO of White Globe. She has more than 20 years of experience and has worked in very Senior Roles in Customer Service, Operations, Process Improvement and Learning Management in Telecom and Consumer Electronics industry. She has handled varied roles as Head-Training, Culture and Organisational Development in one of the leading Electronics and Consumer Appliances Company, Head-Global Contact Centre and Head Customer Service for large telecom companies. Sheetal Ramkumar is a certified TL 9000 Internal Auditor and a Certified Six Sigma Green Belt. She has completed her MBA in Marketing and Post-Graduation in Advertising, Marketing and Communication from a leading Business School in India.

name: Swati Bhargava
bio: Swati Bhargava is India’s one of the most awarded and famous young women entrepreneur. Swati Bhargava is the Co-Founder of CashKaro.Swati Bhargava is honored amongst top 10 women entrepreneurs in India and is also an acclaimed Social Media influencer. Swati is an alumnus of the London School of Economics and has worked at Goldman Sachs in London for 5 years before starting UK Cashback business Pouring Pounds along with her husband & Co-Founder, Rohan.

name: Supriya Paul
bio: Supriya Paul was just 20 years old when she co-founded Josh talks. She also wrote a book called – All you need is Josh: Stories of Courage and Conviction in 21st century India. Supriya Paul was born in New Delhi and studied at Shri Venkateshwara College, Delhi and at Stanford. Her father has been an inspirational figure for her. She considers her biggest failure when she couldn’t get into Shri Ram College of Commerce but as time went by she realized that success and failure are part of a bigger journey.

name: Vanita Prasad
bio: Environmental Biotechnologist having experience of more than 30 yrs. Vanita Prasad floated her own company in 2017 by the name of REVY Environmental Solution Private Ltd. REVY has been started because of three reasons: one, her unending urge to learn; two, to provide society effective Waste Management scheme to fulfil the mission of SWACH BHARAT and three, her belief that innovation in businesses is nothing by chance but by doing constant research.

name: Basudha Shrivastav
bio: Basudha Shrivastav is the Managing Director of Empfly Services Pvt Ltd, a bespoke SaaS company that provides customized business solutions. Before that, she has worked with Serco for their IT Projects and team leads. Basudha Shrivastav is a software engineering Diploma holder from GNIIT, 2006. Post it, she received her B.A. honours in English. She has thrust for knowledge & this can be seen looking at her career graph. She handled many critical projects to provide service efficiency, accuracy, automation and provide ease to the workforce.

name: Kirti Goel
bio: Ms. Kirti Goel, co-founder and head designer of P-TAL, has a knack for noticing the lesser noticed parts of the environment around her which is what makes her design thinking process unique. Kirti Goel has proven experience in conceptualising a young generation artisan community centric brand from sourcing, grassroots capacity building, and design development to improving operational efficiency and enabling marketing across multiple channels.

name: Pooja Kaul
bio: Pooja Kaul is a social enterprise based in India that utilizes donkey milk (a popular beauty treatment in ancient Egypt) to produce skincare products. Organiko helps donkey farmers and owners in the lesser-known Indian territories of Solapur, Ghaziabad and Dasna earn income by selling the milk, as well as women by teaching them how to make skincare products from it.

name: Shilpa Malik
bio: Shilpa Malik is the founder and CTO of Bioscan Research, which has received over 20 accolades, most recently the American Society of Mechanical Engineers prize in healthcare for its breakthrough brain haemorrhage detector, Cerebo. She is a computer science engineer with an entrepreneurship management degree from India and postgraduate training from Technion Israel, Judge Business School in the United Kingdom, and Carleton University in Canada. She is a former Defence Research and Development scientist who worked on the design and development of military sensor systems.

name: Ruchi Gupta
bio: Dr. Ruchi Gupta, 3hcare.in’s founder and CEO, is a Fellow of the Indian Institute of Chartered Accountants. Dr. Ruchi Gupta graduated with an MBA from Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University and a doctorate from B. R. Ambedkar University in Agra. She completed her B. Com(H) at the University of Delhi’s SRCC. She has worked in the education sector for ten years in a variety of roles, instructing graduate and postgraduate students in corporate finance and management.

name: Archana Elapavuluri
bio: Archana Elapavuluri is the Co-Founder and Chief executive officer at Pickright Technologies. She has more than a decade of experience in technical product development for retail B2B/C e-commerce, telecom, gaming, and investment domains. Archana Elapavuluri has completed her Masters in Computer Science from Kakatiya University, Archana boasts of a 23-year-long career during which she has handled key roles across an array of companies

name: Anushree Goenka
bio: Anushree Goenka, Co-Founder & CEO at Spark Studio, has years of experience as a business leader and is skilled in P&L management, revenue development, digital consumer experiences, and business strategy. Anushree Goenka was one of the young founders who mustered the courage to take a plunge into the world of entrepreneurship just ahead of the onset of the second wave of the pandemic.

name: Farah Nathani Menzies
bio: Farah Nathani-Menzies is a Co-founder at The Mumum Company (The Mumum Co). She worked in international business at Godrej Consumer Products Ltd., concentrating on post-merger integration in Latin America, prior to starting The Mumum Co. Later, she relocated to India to take on a leadership role in Godrej Industries’ strategic projects and diversity. She started off at the New York office of Bain and Company as a management consultant.

name: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw
bio: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw is an entrepreneur, Indian tycoon and billionaire. In addition to being the previous chair of the Indian Institute of Management, Bangalore, she is the executive chairperson and founder of Biocon Limited and Biocon Biologics Limited, two biotechnology companies with headquarters in Bangalore, India. With more than 40 years of experience in biotechnology, Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw is a first-generation entrepreneur and prominent figure in international business. She began her biotech career in 1978 from her garage in India, driven by her passion. Today, that quest is improving people’s lives all across the world.

name: Shradha Sharma
bio: Shradha Sharma is an Indian journalist and entrepreneur. She is the founder and CEO of YourStory. Shradha Sharma was born in Patna, Bihar, India. She shifted to New Delhi in 1997. She did a bachelor’s and master’s degree in history from St. Stephen’s College, Delhi. She completed her master’s degree from Mudra Institute of Communications Ahmedabad. Sharma started her career being a brand advisor at The Times of India. After that, she worked as an assistant vice president at the business channel CNBC TV18. In 2008, she found her news portal YourStory.

name: Megha Desai Asher
bio: Megha Desai Asher, Co-Founder & COO of Juicy Chemistry, dedicated to natural and organic skincare has earned her a loyal customer base and a reputation as a trusted and reliable source of high-quality skincare products. Juicy Chemistry has grown into a well-known and prosperous company in a short period of time, offering a variety of goods that consumers adore all over the world.

name: Shahnaz Husain
bio: Shahnaz Husain is an Indian businesswoman who was the founder, chairperson and managing director of The Shahnaz Husain Group. She has received international acclaim for pioneering the Herbal beauty care movement and taking the Indian herbal heritage of Ayurveda worldwide.

name: Radhika Ghai Aggarwal
bio: Radhika Ghai Aggarwal is an Internet entrepreneur and India’s first woman to enter the Unicorn Club. She is the co-founder of online marketplace ShopClues. Radhika Ghai Aggarwal was born to an Army family. She has an MBA from Washington University in St. Louis and holds a post-graduation degree in advertising and public relations.

name: Ekta Kapoor
bio: Ekta Kapoor is an Indian Film/TV Producer and Director who works in Hindi cinema. She is the joint managing director and creative head of Balaji Telefilms Limited. Ekta Kapoor was honored with the Padma Shri in 2020 for her work in the field of arts. Ekta Kapoor has also launched a number of TV series online through her digital app ALTBalaji.

name: Suruchi Wagh
bio: Suruchi Wagh is the Founder and Chief Product Officer of Jombay, a company that specialises in talent assessment and capability development. Suruchi Wagh believes in bringing consumer-level user experience to enterprise and producing solutions. She is adamant that there is no such thing as a self-made man or a one-man show, and that it is the modest ideas that emerge from every area of the organisation that distinguishes it as an innovative company.

name: Meena Ganesh
bio: Meena Ganesh had a successful corporate career when she decided to enter the world of business. She is currently busy establishing Portea Medical, a home healthcare firm, as its Co-founder and Chairperson, using her experience mentoring other start-ups.

name: Rashmi Daga
bio: Rashmi Daga is the founder & CEO of Fresh Menu, Bangalore-based an online food delivery service that aims to deliver freshly prepared food at your home or office desk. Rashmi is an IIM- A graduate, Before she found her own online kitchen, she has dabbled in several industries – education, jewelry, IT, medical, and cab services.

name: Upasana Taku
bio: Upasana Taku is the COO and board chair of MobiKwik, a company she co-founded with her husband. Punjab Technical University awarded her an engineering degree. She later earned a master’s degree in management science and engineering from Stanford University.

name: Shivani Poddar
bio: Shivani Poddar is FabAlley’s Co-Founder. Shivani Poddar formerly worked as an Associate at Avendus Capital and as a Finance Manager at Hindustan Unilever Limited. She has a Master’s degree from the University of Delhi’s Faculty of Management Studies.

name: Sayali Karanjkar
bio: Sayali Karanjkar, Co-founder of PaySense, a Mumbai-based fintech business, is working to make credit more accessible and inexpensive to everybody. Sayali Karanjkar has worked in operational and strategic consultative roles at significant corporations (AT&T and ATKearney) in the United States for over 14 years.

name: Priyanka Kanwar
bio: Priyanka Kanwar is the Co-founder of Falcon, one of India’s fastest-growing fintech infrastructure companies, a BaaS startup based in Delhi and Bangalore in India. She’s been immersed in fintech for almost a decade and has closely observed and participated in the ups and downs the industry has gone through in India. She has an economics degree from Yale University.

name: Sabina Chopra
bio: Sabina Chopra is the Chief Operating Officer of Corporate Hotels at Yatra Online, Inc. and a co-founder of the company. With over 16 years of professional experience, Sabina Chopra has an in-depth understanding of all aspects of the travel BPO industry and a wide-ranging network within the Indian travel community. She worked at Yatra Online, Inc. as the Executive Vice President of Operations. Before joining Yatra, Ms. Chopra oversaw operations for ebookers, the biggest online travel agency in Europe, with a base in India.

name: Saumya Singh Rathore
bio: Saumya Singh is co-founder of WinZO, one of India’s fastest growing vernacular gaming platforms. Saumya Singh Rathore had a long corporate career before she decided to take the leap and become an entrepreneur. In just 3 years of its inception, the startup she co-founded with a fellow colleague reached a valuation of over $300 million.

name: Sneha Choudhry
bio: Sneha Choudhry, an IIM Kozhikode gold medallist, is co-founder of Zolo, one of the biggest co-living firms. Sneha writes about issues such as fund raising for female entrepreneurs and is a proponent of work-life balance. Having launched two businesses, Sneha thinks that an entrepreneur needs to have a particular kind of thinking, a strong sense of purpose, and a lot of tenacity.

name: Vineeta Singh
bio: Vineeta Singh is the Co-Founder and CEO of SUGAR Cosmetics, India’s fastest growing beauty brand with 35000+ branded retail outlets in over 540 cities. She is one of the sharks on the reality show Shark Tank India, and she is dedicated to inventing items that would allow every Indian woman to discover a favourite and motivate them to embark on their own entrepreneurial adventure.

name: Dr. Garima Sawhney
bio: The co-founder of Pristyn Care, Dr. Garima Sawhney, has led a colourful life. She is a physician, among the greatest in her specialty (gynaecology). In her family, Garima Sawhney is the first physician. Her father suggested that she pursue gynaecology since it was a successful venture for women.

name: Kanika Gupta
bio: Kanika Gupta is a complex woman who aspires to be the best in whatever role she takes on. Kanika Gupta holds the positions of COO and Co-Founder at Square Yards, in addition to her certification as a scuba diver and her many other accomplishments. Six months after giving birth to her second child, she began her entrepreneurial career. She has entirely transformed the Indian real estate sector in a few of years.

name: Ankita sheth
bio: Ankita Sheth is the Co-Founder and Head of Acquisitions and Human Resources at Vista Rooms, South Asia’s largest brand of boutique vacation home rentals. Ankita Sheth did her post-graduate studies at Mumbai Educational Trust (MET) and an M.Com. at Mumbai University before embarking on her entrepreneurial journey. She was raised in an enterprising joint family in Mumbai, where she was exposed to the difficulties of running a business from a young age. She observed her father and uncles operating their family business in Africa for over four decades, and she knew from an early age that she, too, would do something of her own.

name: Sadiya Naseem
bio: Sadiya Naseem, the Founder and CEO of glamstudios.in, is a vibrant entrepreneur with a unique blend of commercial and technological talents. Sadiya Naseem has over a decade of cross-domain internet experience in the travel, retail, media, and education industries, with a focus on enhancing startup profitability and performance.

name: Falguni Nayar
bio: Falguni Nayar is the founder and CEO of the beauty and lifestyle retail company Nykaa. Falguni Nayar completed her postgraduate studies at the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad after earning her B.Com. from Sydenham College of Commerce and Economics. alguni has received many accolades throughout her career. She was awarded the ‘Woman Ahead’ award at the Economic Times Startup Awards 2017. In the last year alone, recognising her contribution to the Indian beauty industry, Falguni was awarded the Businesswoman of the Year at the Economic Times Awards for Corporate Excellence 2019

name: Chitra Gurnani Daga
bio: Chitra Gurnani Daga is the Co-Founder & Chief Executive Officer of Thrillophilia trips Pvt. Ltd., an organisation that offers adventure trips and travel. Chitra is one of the women who reveres her work rather than viewing it as solely a means of generating money. She worked tirelessly with a focus on creating a company that benefits both its consumers and staff. She has been recognized by the Ministry of External Affairs, Govt of India, for her outstanding work in tourism, besides this she has been featured in multiple magazines and digital channels as India’s top women entrepreneurs.

name: Ruchi Deepak
bio: Ruchi Deepak is the Co-founder of Acko Insurance. Ruchi, who has worked in both India and the United Kingdom, has advised on some of the most complex funding, exits, IPO, and strategic matters in industries ranging from healthcare, retail, ecommerce, manufacturing, IT, and mobile.

name: Diane Hendricks
bio: Diane Hendricks is the chairperson and sole owner of ABC Supply, the largest wholesale distributor of roofing materials in the United States. Diane Hendricks did not inherit from celebrities or political leaders. Instead, she spent her childhood on a dairy farm in Wisconsin, developing a work ethic that would eventually help her build a corporate empire.

name: Judy Faulkner
bio: Judy Faulkner created Epic Systems, a healthcare software firm based in Verona, Wisconsin. She is also completely self-made and one of the top 10 richest (BILLIONAIRE) women in the United States Judy Faulkner’s parents sparked her early interest in healthcare: her father, Louis, was a chemist, and her mother, Del, was the director of Oregon Physicians for Social Responsibility.

name: Thai Lee
bio: Thai Lee, a Thai-born Korean American successful businesswoman, is the co-founder, CEO, and president of SHI International, an IT provider that specialises in building cloud, data centre, and end-user computing strategies. Thai Lee graduated from Amherst College in Amherst, Massachusetts, with a double major BA in biology and economics, and an MBA from Harvard Business School in 1985.

name: Melanie Perkins
bio: Melanie Perkins is an Australian billionaire technology entrepreneur who is the CEO and co-founder of Canva. Melanie Perkins was born in Perth, West Australia. She is the daughter of an Australian-born teacher and a Malaysian engineer with Filipino and Sri Lankan ancestry. Perkins has also been extensively over the world, describing a trip to India as a life-changing experience.

name: Oprah Winfrey
bio: Oprah Winfrey, also known simply as Oprah, is an American talk show host, television producer, actress, author, and media mogul. She is best known for her chat show, The Oprah Winfrey Show. Working in local media, Winfrey was both the youngest and the first black female news anchor.

name: Richa Kar
bio: Richa Kar, the creator of Zivame, overcame a number of obstacles along the way to becoming a successful entrepreneur and taking charge of a multibillion rupee enterprise. Richa Kar was born in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, into a middle-class family. Richa developed the idea to open an online lingerie store while working on a Victoria’s Secret-related project where she learned about the challenges women experience when looking for undergarments.

name: Safra Catz
bio: Safra Catz is an Israeli-American billionaire banker and technology executive. Safra Catz is the CEO of Oracle Corporation. She earned a law degree at the University of Pennsylvania and worked on Wall Street for 14 years covering the software industry. Catz is the highest paid female CEO of any U.S. company as of April 2017, earning $40.9 million after a 23% drop in her total compensation relative to 2016.

name: Tory Burch
bio: Tory Burch is an American fashion designer, businesswoman, and philanthropist. She is the Executive Chairman and Chief Creative Officer of her own brand, Tory Burch LLC. Tory Burch has consistently been included on Forbes‘ list of The World’s 100 Most Powerful Women.

name: Sara Blakely
bio: Sara Blakely is an American businesswoman and philanthropist. She founded Spanx, an American intimate apparel firm comprising trousers and leggings based in Atlanta, Georgia. In 2012, Sara Blakely became the world’s youngest female self-made billionaire. Blakely graduated from Florida State University with a bachelor’s degree in communications. Blakely quickly developed an empire without advertising or outside money. Never refusing to pass up an opportunity to promote Spanx, Blakely acted as her own model on television and at in-store public appearances around the United States.

name: Anita Dongre
bio: Anita Dongre is an Indian fashion designer. She is the founder of House of Anita Dongre, an Indian fashion label. Anita Dongre was born in Mumbai, Maharashtra. Her mother, Pushpa Sawlani, used to sew clothing for Anita and her siblings. Anita thereafter went on to study fashion design at Mumbai’s SNDT College. She earned a degree in fashion design.

name: Anjana Reddy Tikkavarapu
bio: Anjana Reddy is the founder of Universal Sportsbiz, an Indian fashion firm that owns a number of celebrity-endorsed companies specialising in fashionable clothes and accessories, such as Collectabillia, Wrogn and Imara. Her brands are sold in over 70 locations and on e-commerce platforms such as Myntra. Indian cricketer Virat Kohli co-owns Wrogn, and cricket icon Sachin Tendulkar is a co-investor in Collectabillia.

name: Priya Sharma
bio: Priya Sharma is the CFO, COO, and Co-Founder of ZestMoney, India’s largest and fastest-growing Digital EMI/Checkout Finance Platform. She formerly worked at Wonga, where she was responsible for strategic analysis of worldwide markets, as well as Bank of America Merrill Lynch, and as a management and technology consultant for Deloitte and Sapient Corporation.

name: Sucharita Mukherjee
bio: Sucharita is the co-founder and CEO of Kaleidofin, a fintech platform that offers underbanked customers simple and personalised financial solutions. She previously co-founded the IFMR group and most recently served as IFMR Holdings’ Group CEO. She created and developed IFMR Capital, which promotes capital market access for financial inclusion, as well as IFMR Investments, an alternative fund management platform specialising on informal sector financing. She earned an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad and an undergraduate degree in economics from Lady Shri Ram College, Delhi University.

name: Sayali Karanjkar
bio: Sayali Karanjkar is the co-founder of Paysense. Sayali spent over 14 years in the United States and Singapore working with industry leaders, honing her skills in consumer products, technology, and healthcare. Her mission was clear: to empower young women in India by offering credit cards and loans, allowing them to pursue their career goals and help their families during difficult times.

name: Paroma Chatterjee
bio: Paroma Chatterjee is the Chief Executive Officer of Revolut. She is a well-known leader in the fintech and consumer tech industries, having been designated one of the “Top 25 Women Leaders in Financial Technology of Asia” in 2020. Paroma Chatterjee is an industry leader in the banking and fintech domain.

name: Karishma Mehta
bio: Karishma Mehta also works as a photographer. In addition to writing the companion book, Humans of Bombay, she is the creator and manager of the website, which debuted in January 2014. She presents at TEDx and writes for a living. She spent two years in a boarding school in Bangalore and three years at a college in the United Kingdom. Mehta graduated from the University of Nottingham in 2013 with a degree in Business and Economics. She studied economics and business at Nottingham, UK.

name: Hardika Shah
bio: Hardika Shah is the founder and CEO of Kinara Capital, a rapidly developing MSME fintech that promotes financial inclusion among small company entrepreneurs in India. Hardika Shah earned a B.A. in Computer Science from Knox College in Illinois, USA. She received her MBA from a dual programme at Columbia Business School and UC Berkeley’s Haas School of Business. She worked as a management consultant for nearly two decades, completing complicated projects for worldwide organisations in the United States, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

name: Deena Jacob
bio: Deena Jacob is the head of revenue and growth, CFO, and co-founder of Open. She’s been creating and leading financial teams from the ground up for early-stage firms for more than eighteen years. Along with end-to-end financial activities, she has led teams in a wide variety of functional areas, including SME credit and marketing, investment research, company finance and analytics, investor relations, strategic alliances, legal, and compliance sectors.

name: Mayurakshi Das
bio: Mayurakshi Das is the founder of Elixir AI, a proprietary AI-enabled technology solutions company that offers digital intervention and infrastructure to municipalities and private businesses. Experienced Experiential Marketing specialist with a proven track record of creating, implementing, and managing comprehensive marketing programmes. Mayurakshi grew raised in Pune, where her father from Burma (Myanmar) and mother from Assam had settled to start their lives. She had always aspired to make the best use of India’s potential and resources.

name: Pooja Rao
titleAtOrg: Head Of Research And Development and Co-Founder
primaryJobTitle: Head Of Research And Development and Co-Founder
bio: Pooja Rao is the R&D Head and Co-Founder of Qure.ai. She holds an MBBS from the Maharashtra University of Health Sciences and a PhD in Neuroscience from the International Max Planck Research School for Neuroscience in Germany. Pooja was a resident physician at Aditya Birla Memorial Hospital. She also worked as a Research Scientist – Bioinformatics at Genome Scan. Before co-founding Qure.ai, Pooja worked with Kolabtree as freelance data scientist and GoData Driven as a data scientist.

name: Ankita Vashistha
industry: Venture Capital and Private Equity Principals
bio: StrongHer Ventures’ founder and managing partner is Ms. Ankita Vashistha. At Saha Fund, Ms. Vashistha is the Managing Partner and Chief Executive Officer in addition to being the founder. She is a member of the GoCoop board as well. At Velmeni, she is a board member. At Gingercrush, she is a board member. She graduated with a bachelor’s degree in English from VTU in India and an MSc in finance from the Cranfield School of Management in the UK. Her experience includes venture capital and private equity, with an emphasis on technology and innovation in the UK, USA, and emerging countries. She has made investments in over 100 firms worldwide.

name: Naiyya Saggi
bio: Naiyya Saggi is the creator of BabyChakra, the most reputable parenting portal in India, as well as co-founder and board member of the Good Glamm Group, which is India’s largest and fastest-growing D2C house of brands. She received a Fulbright and Tata Scholarship while attending Harvard Business School, where she earned her MBA in 2012. She also holds a legal degree from National Law School in Bangalore, where she was voted University President and graduated with a BA.LLB (Hons).

name: K. Suriya Prabha
bio: K. Suriya Prabha hails from a small town in Tamil Nadu. She studied microbiology before discovering her interest for computer science and founding Youcode Intelligence Solutions. Youcode Intelligence Solutions develops students’ consumable interactive artificial intelligence learning content that is both enjoyable and gamified. Suriya Prabha is running an Artificial Intelligence for Kids (AI4KIDS) effort to help rural and small-town Indian students improve their technology skills.

name: Megha Gambhir
bio: Megha Gambhir, the co-founder and CEO of Stupa Sports Analytics, uses technology to help players and coaches better their game through performance analysis. An IT expert turned entrepreneur, a sports enthusiast focused on sports performance analytics and data science. She is a seasoned management expert and technologist who focuses on data, video analytics, and artificial intelligence in sports.

name: Sri Sailaja Nori
bio: Sri Sailaja Nori is the Co-Founder and Chief Scientific Officer of Sea6 Energy Pvt Ltd. She supervises the development of innovative methods by the research team to transform macroalgae into food ingredients, biofuel, animal feed, agricultural biostimulants, and other renewable compounds. Co-author of five articles and co-inventor of five patents (two of which have been approved) on goods produced from sea plants, she was recognized as a special mention in the “Science and Green Tech category” in Forbes India’s 2018 “30 under 30” list.

name: Manjiri Bakre
bio: Manjiri Bakre is the CEO and founder of OncoStem Diagnostics, a start-up with an oncology emphasis that creates cutting-edge testing for the most effective and individualized treatment planning. She is a veteran of cell biology with vast knowledge in a variety of technological fields, including proteomics, microfluidic tests, AI/ML, and microarrays. She has worked in academia and industry for more than 20 years, conducting basic and applied research in Singapore, the US, and India.

name: Lynda Resnick
bio: Lynda Resnick is the vice-chairman and co-owner of The Wonderful Company, with her husband, Stewart Resnick, who serves as chairman. Her commitment to philanthropy has developed along her commercial success throughout her career. Lynda Resnick personally oversees The Wonderful Company’s creative charitable endeavors, the heart of which focuses on wide-ranging efforts to enhance the lives of people in the communities where its employees live and work.

name: Anu Acharya
bio: Anu Acharya is the CEO and Co-Founder of Mapmygenome, a renowned genomics business that uses innovative molecular testing to offer individualized and prophylactic medical care. She is a renowned inventor and expert in genetics and bioinformatics with over 20 years of expertise. Anu Acharya also acts as a mentor and/or member of the governing board for several prestigious organizations, including ABLE, NIBMG, NIAB, IIITHyderabad, IvyCap Ventures, and CSIR. She is a Young Global Leader at the World Economic Forum and a renowned alumni of IIT Kharagpur.

name: Jayanti Rajagopalan
bio: Jayanti Rajagopalan also known as Jonty was born into a South Indian family but grew up in Jamshedpur, an industrial town in the Eastern part of India known for its cosmopolitan culture. She completed her MBA from XLRI Jamshedpur and joined Titan Industries in 1995. For the next almost 14 years, her work in Sales & Marketing with Titan and a brief 3-year stint with the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation took her to various parts of India. In 2008, Jayanti Rajagopalan decided to start Detours, a company focused on showcasing the country through its culture, traditions and food rather than just through its historical monuments.

name: Suchitra Ella
bio: Suchitra Ella is the Co-founder and Managing Director of Bharat Biotech International Limited, a company that has provided over 5 billion vaccination doses to the world’s most impoverished and underprivileged communities. Ella provided strategic leadership in the development of COVAXIN®, the first vaccine against SARS-CoV-2 produced in India.

name: Gail Miller
bio: Gail Miller is the owner of the Larry H. Miller Group, which operates in real estate, healthcare, finance, and entertainment. In 2018, she released the book “Courage To Be You: Inspiring Lessons From An Unexpected Journey.” Miller was born in Sandy, Utah on October 14, 1943. Her father was a shoemaker, while her mother worked as a housewife.

name: Eren Ozmen
bio: Eren Ozmen is a billionaire Turkish-American businesswoman, and the majority co-owner and president of the private aerospace and defense company, Sierra Nevada Corporation. Ozmen has been featured on the coveted list since its inception, this year among the Top 10 tied with Oprah Winfrey. Ozmen’s vision for making a positive impact extends well beyond the walls of her companies.

name: Jaya Jha
bio: Jaya Jha is a writer, poet, IT geek, and businesswoman. She was raised in several towns in Jharkhand and Bihar after being born. She graduated from IIT Kanpur and IIM Lucknow, and she quickly came to the conclusion that the corporate environment was not for her. She worked for a startup and Google India before founding Pothi, the country’s top print-on-demand publishing platform, in 2008.

name: Sneha Choudhry
bio: Sneha Choudhry, an IIM Kozhikode gold medallist, is co-founder of Zolo, one of the biggest co-living firms. Advocate of the adage “the devil is in the details,” Sneha writes about women entrepreneurs collecting money and supports work-life balance. Having started two businesses, Sneha thinks that an entrepreneur has to have a certain kind of thinking, a strong sense of purpose, and a lot of tenacity.

name: Garima Satija
bio: Garima Satija introduced PoshVine, a marketplace and platform for adventure and travel seekers. It provides distinctive travel opportunities. She worked for Naukri.com and a few other organizations, including Ozone Media, before launching her business. She graduated from Lucknow University with a degree in psychology and Amity Business School with a degree in human resource management.

name: Arum Kang
bio: Arum Kang came up with the idea for Coffee Meets Bagel while attending Harvard Business School to get his MBA. She was one of the few members of the 2011 HBS MBA class who went on to launch their own company. Together with her older sister Soo and twin sister Dawoon, Arum manages the millennial-focused app. They even made a presentation to a group of well-known investors on the US reality TV program Shark Tank in 2015. The Kang sisters are originally from South Korea and hail from a family of business owners. Their mother operated a chain of pubs and restaurants, while their father had his own scrap iron company.

name: Emma Chamberlain
bio: Emma Chamberlain, a London, UK-based founder of Mama + Max, brings experience from her past positions at ALTER, Tea & Cake PR, and Balance PR. Emma Chamberlain graduated with honors from Birmingham City University’s Fashion Retail Management program in 2004–2007. With a broad range of expertise in Public Relations, Fashion, Social Media, Brand Management, and more, Emma Chamberlain offers insightful perspectives to the field.

name: Aditi Gupta
bio: Aditi Gupta has worked as a menstruation educator for the past 8 years. She graduated from the National Institute of Design in Ahmedabad. She has a profound knowledge of the discomfort people experience while talking about the subject because she experienced period-related stigmas firsthand while growing up. Aditi Gupta has therefore been dedicated to dispelling period myths and taboos through Menstrupedia, a project she co-founded that employs comic books and relevant media to de-stigmatize menstruation.

name: Juhi Godambe
bio: Juhi is a content producer for luxury and fashion. Even in her early years, she had a deep connection to fashion. Juhi began her work as a fashion stylist at the age of 19, and to further her understanding of the fashion industry, she obtained a degree in purchasing and merchandising at the London School of Trends. Arabellaa was born not long after she arrived back in Bombay. Initially conceived upon as a series of concepts, it opened its initial location at Phoenix Marketcity in Mumbai.The famous makeup artists Bharat and Dorris Godambe’s daughter. At fashion weeks, international fashion events, and significant launches, she serves as a worldwide representative of India in the fashion blogging field. She also started the company Arabellaa.

name: Simran Bhatia
bio: Originally from the lovely city of Indore, Simran Bhatia was born on November 30, 1996. She graduated with a BMBS from Indore’s Daly College Business School. In her sophomore year of college, Simran began her career as a blogger at the age of 18. Later, in 2017, she and her sister Dolcy Bhatia established their own online fashion retailer, Swish Boss.

name: Samantha Jones
bio: The CEO and founder of Little Yellow Bird, Samantha Jones, is a social entrepreneur who is promoting circular methods of design, manufacturing, and consumption. In addition to being an Edmund Hillary Fellow and a 2017 Young Innovator of the Year recipient in New Zealand, Samantha holds master’s degrees in both engineering management and international security. Supply Chain Management is Samantha’s prior experience. For six years prior to founding Little Yellow Bird, she was a Logistics Officer in the Royal New Zealand Air Force.

name: Alyona Medelyan
bio: Alyona Medelyan, Ph.D. is the CEO and Co-Founder of Thematic, a YCombinator-backed AI-powered customer feedback solution. Alyona is a PhD candidate in artificial intelligence and is originally from Ukraine. Three thousand five hundred researchers worldwide have referenced her scholarly work in this topic. After seeing how difficult it was for businesses to comprehend feedback at scale, she founded Thematic. She created a solution that makes use of AI in a trustworthy manner.

name: Brough Johnson
bio: Born and raised in the United States, Brough Johnson is the CEO and co-founder of Narrative Muse, a cutting-edge digital platform that pairs users’ personalities with books, movies, and TV series by women and gender nonconforming people from diverse backgrounds. The platform bases its recommendations on users’ identities, preferences, and moods rather than past consumption.

name: Shalini Divya
bio: Shalini Divya, TasmanION‘s co-founder, aims to find battery producers and seek assistance from an industry partner that can help them commercialize their idea and achieve mutual advantages. Her Ph.D. at Victoria University of Wellington focused on aluminum-ion batteries (AIBs), a safer and less expensive alternative to lithium-ion batteries, with an emphasis on the synthesis of activated carbon and 2D layered materials as cathodes.

name: Samantha Jones
bio: Samantha Jones is the Founder and CEO of Little Yellow Bird, a social enterprise that is normalising circular approaches to design, and production. Samantha’s background is in Supply Chain Management. She served as a Logistics Officer in the Royal New Zealand Air Force for six years before setting up Little Yellow Bird. Samantha has a Masters in International Security and a Masters in Engineering Management, is an Edmund Hillary Fellow and was recognised as New Zealand’s Young Innovator of the year in 2017.
